responsibility: Implements the SH target’s C-family front-end integration points: machine-specific pragma handlers and preprocessor builtins. It translates Renesas-compatible pragmas such as interrupt/trapa/nosave_low_regs into deferred or immediate function attributes, and defines SH CPU/FPU/endianness/FDPIC/atomic-model predefined macros and assertions according to the selected processor and target options.
